title: Fault rectification of Automation system at Mainland under Goa Directorate
summary: Short e-tender (two-cover) for rectification of existing defects and restoration of the PLC/SCADA automation (remote monitoring) system at 9 mainland lighthouses under Goa Directorate and the Master Control Centre setup at Deep Bhavan, Goa.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa

sites.name: Master Control Centre, Deep Bhavan, Goa
sites.work: Setup of Master Control Centre for automation system

scope.item: Fault rectification of existing defects and restoration of automation system at 09 lighthouses under Goa Directorate (list in Annexure-C, not included)

money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of all taxes. Tender fee Rs 500 non-refundable by DD. EMD by DD/FDR/Banker's cheque/Bank Guarantee (Form 8.1) from any commercial/scheduled bank in favour of Director, Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa, payable at Goa; valid 90 days beyond technical bid opening. Originals of EMD and fee by 03.12.2024 12:00.

period.completion: 02 months from date of award of tender

eligibility: Eligible and registered agencies under Central/State government departments, undertakings or autonomous bodies with experience of similar work: installation or rectification of automation/remote monitoring systems for marine aids to navigation using PLC and SCADA
Detailed eligibility in Section III (not included)
specs: Automation/remote monitoring system for marine AtoN based on PLC and SCADA
notes: Scanned Section 1 short bid notice only (printed pages 3-4); Annexure-C listing the 9 lighthouses not included, so sites not named. Download 22.11.2024 15:00 to 03.12.2024 15:00; bid submission end printed as '02312/2024 (1500 hrs)' (typo, presumably 03.12.2024); pre-bid 27.11.2024 15:00 at Deep Bhavan Goa; technical bid opening 04.12.2024 12:00.
